name: twrses-body
description: 人體探索 3D 模型的原始碼與打包設定。npm run model 從 BodyParts3D 產生 assets/models/*.glb；npm run build 打包成 assets/js/。

scripts.build: esbuild src/skeleton.js src/arm.js src/heart.js src/lungs.js src/joints.js src/digestion.js src/nerves.js src/eyes.js src/ears.js src/skin.js src/teeth.js src/germs.js src/kidneys.js src/taste.js src/sleep.js src/growth.js src/voice.js src/hands.js src/healing.js src/exercise.js src/energy.js src/temperature.js src/back.js src/cells.js src/walking.js src/reflexes.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
